title: Sales KPIs and measures (Power BI)
summary: Power BI semantic model for sales KPIs describing formulas and data sources for customer, opportunity, sales document, Pareto, project ledger, and budget-related measures used in sales analytics reporting.
features: Customer KPIs (lost, new, recovered, returning customers)
Opportunity entry measures and win/loss tracking
Sales document analytics (invoices, credit memos, returns)
